coverage.row: Acceptance 1: Default and { mode: 'initial-deployment-only' } keep an existing Scratch or named project's saved files when only unused snapshot provenance changes, including dirty Scratch without preserveDirtySameStarter; the unused asset is not fetched; catalog adoption stays on the last applied snapshot.

Acceptance 2: { mode: 'apply', conflict?: 'error' | 'overwrite' } evaluates snapshot payload on every requested apply, including unchanged snapshotId. Identical bytes and directory/directory coexistence are not conflicts; different bytes or file-vs-directory/ancestor clashes are. Error throws SnapshotApplicationConflictError with paths before any payload mutation, including additions. Overwrite replaces conflicts, adds missing payload files, and keeps extras. Package filenames are ordinary collision fixtures.

Acceptance 3: After a successful apply, catalog adoption matches the applied snapshot and install claims are retired/rederived through the existing stamp authority; apply does not run an automatic install to manufacture trust. Missing install trust never counts as project absent.
Fault matrix: Structural conflict × apply-error — conflicting paths are reported and the pre-apply tree is byte-identical, including extras and would-be additions.
Fault matrix: Crash/reopen × apply-overwrite — a torn payload write is not published as completed; the preserved copy remains.
Fault matrix: Corrupt/incompatible snapshot × apply — existing snapshot identity/restore failures reject before destination mutation.

Public API: SnapshotApplication ({ mode: 'initial-deployment-only' } | { mode: 'apply'; conflict?: 'error' | 'overwrite' }) on Playground createScratch / openProject; omitted field is initial-deployment-only.
Public API: SnapshotApplicationConflictError (name, paths: readonly string[]) exported from @riftydev/workbench.

findings.summary: The crash/reopen RED is apply-error plus reopen, not a torn apply-overwrite publish. Extras-only apply cases (not-whole-tree-reseed, identical-payload) would keep extras if apply were ignored after initial-only; apply-error and overwrite+pin-b still fail without apply. Catalog last-applied identity after initial-only/apply is not asserted. Advisory (REV-4).
